name: implement-approved-slice
description: Implement only the approved slice with minimal changes, then persist execution evidence in slice notes and TASK_STATE.md. The official execution path. Opt-in test-first mode via --tdd. Use when the plan and slice are approved, ambiguity is resolved and files in scope are known. Do not use during discovery or planning, with open ambiguity, only to sync memory or close a slice (use sync-task-state or slice-closure), or a micro-delta (use implement-slice-complement).
